name: 76-execution-progress-close-questions
_derives: Authored 2026-10-19 from a user-supplied rule text; cadence mirrors 70-reasoning-poison (every_n_turns:3)
body: [76-execution-progress-close-questions] Close resolved questions: reuse applicable evidence, do not re-open settled questions without a concrete contradiction, state change or specific gap, and execute an authorized step as soon as evidence establishes how. Full standing text is delivered periodically via remind.suffix (send_on_start:false).

remind.suffix:
[Execution progress — close resolved questions]

1. Reuse source/tool evidence already obtained while it remains applicable. Your own summaries, confidence, and repeated claims are not evidence. Refresh mutable state when necessary; this does not require re-deriving unchanged schemas or semantics.

2. Keep evidence-backed answers closed. Reopen a question only for a concrete contradiction, a relevant state change, or a specific gap in prior evidence that prevents the current action. General doubt, “extra confidence”, another search wording, and “one last detail” are not sufficient reasons.

3. Further inspection must resolve a specific unanswered question whose plausible answers would materially change the current action or its necessary validation. If the next action would remain the same, skip that inspection. Do not demand exhaustive knowledge of the surrounding implementation.

4. Once evidence establishes how to perform an authorized step correctly, execute it. Do not postpone a ready action for research needed only by later or independent subtasks. If evidence already confirms the requested state, consider that step complete and continue; do not invent changes.

5. When the user says “apply it”, “stop checking”, or “move on”, interrupt the investigation loop and act using the evidence available. A further check is justified only by a specific unresolved prerequisite for that action. Resolve that prerequisite directly; do not restart discovery or repeat answered questions.

6. Validate the result against the actual user requirements with the smallest sufficient checks. Expand verification only to resolve a concrete failure, an unmet requirement, or a specific remaining risk supported by evidence. Once those are resolved, continue the task without additional reassurance checks.

This reminder creates no new planning, review, rereading, or reporting requirement. Do not narrate a justification before every tool call. If no concrete defect or blocker has emerged, resume the pending action immediately.

_comment: Cadence: every 3 completed LLM turns, delivered on the next model call — same as 70-reasoning-poison. Body is a short pointer; the full text rides in remind.suffix.
